entries.name: Documentation for Plugins
entries.description: This offical documentation is good starting point, when writing a Composer plugin.

entries.name: Composer-Asset-Plugin
entries.description: A npm/Bower Dependencies Manager for Composer.

entries.name: Composer-AWS
entries.description: The plugin loads repository data and downloads packages from Amazon S3 (with authentication support for private repositories).

entries.name: Composer-Composition
entries.description: Provides an API, for checking your environment at runtime.

entries.name: Composer-Suggest
entries.description: Enables you to install a custom group of suggested packages, based on keyword patterns.

entries.name: Composer-Versions-Check
entries.description: Shows outdated packages from last major versions after using the update command (showing "Latest is vX.Y.Z").

entries.name: Composer-Changelogs
entries.description: Provides a summary of the updates with links to changelog/releasenote/tag. The output is ready to be pasted into the commit message when updating the composer.lock file.

entries.name: Composer-Merge-Plugin
entries.description: Merges multiple composer.json files at Composer runtime.

entries.name: Composer-Bin-Plugin
entries.description: Adds support for managing dependencies for multiple packages in a single repository or isolate bin dependencies.

entries.name: Composer-Inheritance-Plugin
entries.description: Opinionated version of Wikimedia composer-merge-plugin to work in pair with Bamarni composer-bin-plugin.

entries.name: Composer-MonoRepo-Plugin
entries.description: The plugin helps to manage dependencies for multiple packages in a single repository.

entries.name: Composer-Patches-Plugin
entries.description: Enables you to provide patches for any package from any package. When the dependency is fetched, the patch is applied on top.

entries.name: Composer-Patches
entries.description: The plugin applies a patch from a local or remote file to any required package.

entries.name: Composer-Patches
entries.description: Applies a patch from a local or remote file to any package that is part of a given composer project.

entries.name: Composer-Patchset
entries.description: Automatically fetch, update and apply patches to any composer package with a twist - store the patchset as a composer package itself.

entries.name: Composer-Plugin-QA
entries.description: Comprehensive Plugin for composer to execute PHP Quality assurance Tools.

entries.name: Composer-Cleanup-Plugin
entries.description: Removes tests & documentation folders from the vendor dir.

entries.name: Composer-Cleaner
entries.description: The tool removes unnecessary files and directories from the vendor directory.

entries.name: Composer-Ignore-Plugin
entries.description: Enables you to remove files and folders from the vendor folder (to make a cleaner and smaller deployment to production). It's an alternative to .gitattributes.

entries.name: Composer-Vendor-Cleaner
entries.description: Plugin removes unnecessary development files and directories from vendor directory by glob pattern syntax.

entries.name: Composer-Skrub
entries.description: The plugin helps to remove junk from Composer installations and trim build sizes.

entries.name: Drupal Vendor Hardening Composer Plugin
entries.description: Removes extraneous directories from the project's vendor directory & adds .htaccess and web.config files to the root of the project's vendor directory.

entries.name: Composer-Shared-Package-Plugin
entries.description: Allows you to share selected packages between your projects by creating symlinks.

entries.name: Composer-Symlinker
entries.description: Enables you to load packages from different directories (instead of loading them from /vendor).

entries.name: Prestissimo
entries.description: A parallel downloader using phpext_curl.

entries.name: Composer-Curl-Plugin
entries.description: The plugin uses phpext_curl for downloading packages.

entries.name: Composer-Custom-Directory-Installer
entries.description: A composer plugin, to install different types of composer packages in custom directories outside the default composer installation path (vendor folder).

entries.name: Composer-Dependency-Analyzer
entries.description: The plugin helps to find dependency issues, including dead, unused, shadow and misplaced dependencies.

entries.name: Composer-Dependency-Analyzer
entries.description: Allows you to build a dependency graph for an installed composer project.

entries.name: Graph-Composer
entries.description: Provides a graph visualization for your project's composer.json and its dependencies.

entries.name: PackageVersions
entries.description: Provides a very quick and easy access to installed composer dependency versions.

entries.name: PackageVersions Deprecated
entries.description: Is a fork of Ocramius/PackageVersions providing compatibility with Composer 1 and 2 on PHP 7+.

entries.name: Composer-Locator
entries.description: Provides a means of locating the installation path for a given Composer package name.

entries.name: PackageInfo
entries.description: Enables you to retrieve all package informations (like version, tag, release date, description).

entries.name: Composer-Git-Hooks
entries.description: A library for easily managing git hooks in your composer config.

entries.name: Symfony-Flex
entries.description: Provides recipe-based installation and configuration management for Symfony packages.

entries.name: Narrowspark-Automatic
entries.description: Automates the most common tasks of applications, boost package downloads, adds a composer security audit and more.

entries.name: PHPCodeSniffer-Composer-Installer
entries.description: The plugin enables you to install PHP_CodeSniffer coding standards (rulesets).

entries.name: Composer-Warmup
entries.description: The plugin adds the command warmup-opcode to Composer, which triggers the compilation of all PHP files discovered in your project into the Opcache.

entries.name: Foxy
entries.description: Composer plugin that executes npm/yarn packages installation operations, when composer package is installed or updated.

entries.name: NodeJS-Installer
entries.description: Installer for Node.js and npm.

entries.name: Node-Composer
entries.description: Installer for Node.js, npm and yarn.

entries.name: Imposter-Plugin
entries.description: Wrapping all composer vendor packages inside your own namespace. Intended for WordPress plugins.

entries.name: Composer Preload
entries.description: The plugin generates a vendor/preload.php file to warm up the Opcache.

entries.name: PHP Inc
entries.description: Automatically includes files for autoload and autoload-dev to facilitate using functions and grouped definitions within composer loaded applications.

entries.name: Composer Registry Manager
entries.description: Enables you to switch between different composer repositories.

entries.name: Production-Dependencies-Guard
entries.description: Prevents development packages from being added into require and getting into production environment.

entries.name: Composer-Plugin-Exclude-Files
entries.description: A plugin for excluding files required by packages using the 'files' autoloading mechanism.

entries.name: Composer-Downloads-Plugin
entries.description: Lightweight mechanism to download external resources (ZIP/TAR files) with only a url and path.

entries.name: Private-Composer-Installer
entries.description: Install helper outsourcing sensitive keys from the package URL into environment variables.

entries.name: CycloneDX-PHP-Composer
entries.description: Creates a CycloneDX "Software Bill-of-Materials" (SBOM) for the dependencies of a project. The SBOM enables dependency monitoring and risk analysis by OWASP DependencyTrack.

entries.name: Composer-Compile-Plugin
entries.description: Allow PHP libraries to define simple, freeform compilation tasks. Support post-install hooks in any package.

entries.name: Composer-Link
entries.description: Adds the ability to link local packages for development.

entries.name: Composer-REPL
entries.description: The plugin provides the composer repl command, which gives you a PHP language shell (read-eval-print loop).

entries.name: Composer-Diff
entries.description: Compares composer.lock changes and generates a Markdown report for usage in a pull request description.

entries.name: Composer-Velocita
entries.description: Fast and reliable Composer package downloads using Velocita: a caching reverse proxy that does not require you to modify your projects.

entries.name: Composer Translation Validator
entries.description: Validates translation files in your project, supports several file formats (regarding different frameworks) and provides useful validators for comparison, consistency and syntax checks.

entries.name: Composer-Fanfare
entries.description: Displays a colored ASCII art banner after install/update, with color presets, gradients and animations.

entries.name: Composer SemVer Checker
entries.description: Enables you identify constraint to version resolution issues, by doing a semantic version check for Packagist hosted packages.

entries.name: Composer-Yaml
entries.description: This tool converts composer.yml to composer.json.

entries.name: Studio
entries.description: A workbench for developing Composer packages. Its an alternative to editing dependencies in the vendor folder or using PathRepositories to load a local clone of your dependency into your project.

entries.name: OctoLinker Browser Extension
entries.description: Enables you to navigate Composer/NPM dependencies on GitHub.

entries.name: ComposerRequireChecker
entries.description: A CLI tool to analyze dependencies and verify that no unknown imported symbols are used in the sources of a package.

entries.name: Composer-Unused
entries.description: A CLI tool, which scans your code and shows unused Composer dependencies.

entries.name: Composer-Normalize
entries.description: The plugin helps to keep your composer.json file(s) consistent by restructuring and sorting entries (normalizing).

entries.name: Composer-Service
entries.description: Enables you to run Composer as a service on a remote server.

entries.name: Composer PreferLowest Checker
entries.description: Strictly compare the specified minimum versions of your composer.json with the ones actually used by the prefer-lowest composer update command option.

entries.name: Bramus/Composer-Autocomplete
entries.description: A Bash/Shell autocompletion script for Composer.

entries.name: Composer/Xdebug-Handler
entries.description: Helps you to restart a CLI process without loading the xdebug extension.

entries.name: Composer Semver Range Checker
entries.description: A tool to help check the satisfiable ranges of a composer constraint.

entries.name: ParameterHandler
entries.description: Allows you to manage your ignored parameters when running a composer install or update.

entries.name: Tooly
entries.description: Manage needed PHAR files in your project composer.json. Every PHAR file will be saved in the composer binary directory. Optional with GPG verification for every PHAR.

entries.name: Melody
entries.description: One-file composer scripts.

entries.name: Composer-Travis-Lint
entries.description: Allows you to lint the Travis CI configuration file (.travis.yml).

entries.name: Composer-Multitest
entries.description: Enables you to run a Composer script against multiple, locally installed PHP versions, which are managed by PHPBrew or phpenv.

entries.name: ScriptsDev
entries.description: Enables you to use a scripts-dev section, which triggers scripts only in dev mode.

entries.name: PhantomJS-Installer
entries.description: A Composer Package which installs the PhantomJS binary (Linux, Windows, Mac) into /bin of your project.

entries.name: Composer-Vendor-Cleanup
entries.description: A script which removes whitelisted unnecessary files (like tests/docs etc.) from the vendor directory.

entries.name: Composer-Substitution-Plugin
entries.description: A Composer plugin replacing placeholders in the scripts section by dynamic values.

entries.name: Dependabot
entries.description: Dependabot is a dependency update service. It monitors and updates your dependencies by sending a pull-request. The service is free for public repos and personal account repos.
